channel.title: Path of the Dragon – Blog
channel.description: Recent essays from the Path of the Dragon blog.

item.title: The Wound That Breaks the Ouroboros
item.description: An essay on the wound that interrupts repetition: Odin’s eye, Sophia’s descent, Christ’s cross, and the Serpent-to-Dragon turn from the closed circle into responsibility.

item.title: Forged Peace
item.description: True peace holds a boundary, loves without grasping, and protects what matters without hardening.

item.title: State Before Story and the Fundamental Attribution Error
item.description: Before behaviour becomes character, read the body: nervous-system state, history, load, and context. Compassion becomes sharper when story comes second — and accountability still remains.

item.title: The Retreat Crash: Intensity, Belonging, and Re-Entry
item.description: Why do some high-intensity retreats leave people lit up and then flattened? An evidence-informed map of the intensity stack, false baseline of intimacy, re-entry mismatch, addictive repetition, and high-demand dynamics.

item.title: The Engine of Your Reality: Why Reinforcement Becomes Fate or Path
item.description: Reinforcement is one way repetition becomes structure. Reflection helps us notice what we are practising and choose a different next move.

item.title: The Terror of the Pause: Why We Doomscroll to Avoid the Void
item.description: Doomscrolling is not just weak discipline. The feed is built to hijack attention, and the real practice is learning how to survive the pause without fleeing your own inner data.

item.title: When the Serpent Is Sleeping: The Spirituality of Numbness
item.description: Not every spiritual crisis feels intense. This post explores numbness, adaptive flatness, and how to come back into contact with your life without forcing catharsis.

item.title: The Golden Armor: When Spirituality Becomes Separation
item.description: Spiritual snobbery isn't just arrogance; it's a defence mechanism. Explore the Sage's Shadow and why the Dragon's Path demands descent, not just ascent.

item.title: The Hidden Costs of Incentives
item.description: Money changes what a system rewards, conceals, and makes costly. A practical look at incentives, structural leverage, and where hidden costs land.

item.title: The Sandcastle at the Edge of Chaos
item.description: Why impermanence doesn’t negate devotion—and what that truth changes about love, boundaries, and building a life that can breathe.

item.title: The Digital Horcrux: Why Consciousness Can’t Be Cloned
item.description: A digital copy may preserve memory, voice, and behaviour without establishing continuity of subjectivity. What can we responsibly claim about identity, embodiment, and survival?

item.title: The Art of the Clean Fight: Ethics for the Heat of the Moment
item.description: A concise conflict practice for separating intent from impact, owning observable behaviour, attempting repair, and knowing when safety requires an exit.

item.title: Why Your Intrusive Thoughts Are Not Manifestations
item.description: A trauma-informed distinction between Signal and Static, so participatory reality doesn’t turn into fear-fuel. The Firmament is shaped through coherent choice and action, not involuntary mental noise.

item.title: Anxiety as Signal: Reading the Nervous-System Dashboard
item.description: Anxiety can carry useful information without becoming a verdict. Regulate first, test the alarm against reality, then choose the next response.

item.title: Containment vs. Vibes
item.description: Healing spaces often collapse because they prioritize energy over ethics. Learn the 'Tomorrow Morning Test' and how to distinguish a safe container from a hazardous one using the ECC Lens.

item.title: Why You Hate Your Hero: Unpacking Jealousy as a Golden Shadow
item.description: Jealousy can point to your own unclaimed capacity. Learn to spot the Golden Shadow and reclaim what you project onto the people you admire—and resent.

item.title: Raising Dragons: How to Parent Without Crushing the Serpent
item.description: A tender Dragon-path lens on parenting through meltdowns: hold the child's fire, regulate your own old fear, and set boundaries without crushing aliveness.

item.title: Awakening the Dragon: A Compass for the Soul
item.description: A grounded entry point into the Dragon’s Path: raw life force becoming ethical power through body, shadow, discernment, and lived repair.

item.title: The Vampire in the Temple: Discerning Symbiotic vs. Parasitic Relationships
item.description: A grounded state-before-story lens on relational drain, reciprocal nourishment, consent, and the difference between a stressed person and a parasitic pattern.

item.title: You Are Not Who You Think You Are
item.description: Identity is not a fixed self to find, but a protective pattern to notice, loosen, and inhabit more consciously through body, shadow, archetype, and relationship.

item.title: In an Age of Gurus, Your True North Is Within
item.description: A grounded discernment essay on charisma, spiritual authority, nervous-system data, and the inner Sage that helps you choose guidance without surrendering sovereignty.

item.title: The Dragon’s Yes: Saying Yes with Embodied Discernment
item.description: Explore why a discerning 'yes' is a sacred act on the Dragon’s Path. Learn to move beyond people-pleasing by grounding your choices in embodied truth.

item.title: The Dragon in a Different Skin: Neurodivergence as Archetype
item.description: Reframing neurodivergent burnout through wiring, masking, and archetypal strength. Traits like hyperfocus or justice sensitivity can carry real gifts as well as real costs.

item.title: Beyond Love and Light: Transformation Demands a Dance With Destruction
item.description: A precise Dragon-path essay on the Creator–Destroyer: how real transformation ends false forms without glamorizing chaos, harm, or scorched-earth change.

item.title: Are You Dating Your Past? Attachment, Archetypes & Somatic Memory
item.description: Why we repeat painful relationship patterns—and how the Foundational Relational Matrix and somatic memory can keep scripting love until we learn to meet from the present.

item.title: You Were Never Too Much — You Were Becoming
item.description: A sharper reframe for the ache of being 'too much': intensity as signal, adaptation as strategy, and becoming as the work of building enough vessel for your own life.

item.title: Depression Reframed: When the Fire Goes Underground
item.description: A Dragon-path lens on depression as shutdown, grief, biology, and lost contact moving through the whole person without reducing the state to weakness or moral failure.

item.title: Void Meditation and the Embodied Cosmos: You Are the Gateway
item.description: A sober contemplative introduction to Void Meditation as embodied descent: loosening separation without drifting into dissociation or metaphysical inflation.
